T1.TestPlan_description: Evaluates whether the AI system behaves responsibly by measuring inclusivity, transparency, explainability, cultural sensitivity, fairness, robustness, truthfulness, and bias.

T2.TestPlan_description: Evaluates the quality of AI conversations by measuring topic consistency, coherence, grammatical correctness, lexical diversity, relevance, logical flow, intent recognition, entity recognition, and response fluency.

T3.TestPlan_description: Evaluates whether the AI system applies effective safety guardrails by detecting harmful or inappropriate content, rejecting unsafe requests, limiting hallucinations and bias, and resisting adversarial attacks.

T4.TestPlan_description: Evaluates the AI system's multilingual capabilities, including language coverage, mixed-language understanding, transliterated input handling, language-specific accuracy, and fluency in Indian languages.

T5.TestPlan_description: Evaluates how accurately and reliably the AI system completes requested tasks, including successful completion, correct responses, and appropriate rejection when a task cannot or should not be fulfilled.

T6.TestPlan_description: Evaluates the AI system's operational performance and ability to scale by measuring response time, uptime, error rate, reliability, transaction throughput, and message-volume handling.

T7.TestPlan_description: Evaluates how effectively the AI system protects user privacy and responds safely to misuse, jailbreak attempts, exaggerated safety behavior, privacy-related queries, data leakage risks, and confidence-sensitive requests.
